lesson: A Vimeo thumbnail of a homepage-takeover video legitimately shows the webpage being taken over. Before failing a thumbnail as 'false provenance' or 'website screenshot', verify via oEmbed: fetch https://vimeo.com/api/oembed.json?url=<vimeo_url> and confirm the thumbnail_url hash matches the manifest source_url. If it matches, the image is the genuine Vimeo CDN thumbnail; its visual content reflects the video's subject matter, which may be a website, ad overlay, or UI recording. Failing a correct thumbnail as mislabeled is a false FAIL.

lesson: Before failing a caption as mismatched, fetch the actual source page and check all images on it. On pentagram.com/work/cohere the NEW NATURE image appears as the hero/first asset in the Cohere case study. New Nature is the conceptual framework name within the Cohere identity system, not a separate project. A branded sub-concept or campaign theme (New Nature for Cohere, a Nuit Debout poster for a political campaign) is part of the parent project, not a distinct project. Fail only when the image cannot be found anywhere on the linked source page or when the source page is demonstrably a different project entirely.
